data:
Hello there from Nairobi, Kenya!! 👋

Welcome to the USIU-Africa Virtual Assistant! I'm here to help you with any questions you might have about our university. Whether you're interested in:

- Our academic programs and majors 📚
- Admission requirements and application processes 📝
- Campus facilities and student life 🏫
- Tuition fees and scholarship opportunities 💰
- Upcoming events or academic calendar dates 📅

Feel free to ask me anything about USIU-Africa as an institution, and I'll be happy to provide you with accurate information. How may I assist you today? 😊
